description: This is the main activity class (MainActivity.java) for an Android Wearable app. It manages UI interactions, including gesture detection, dismiss overlay, notifications, and a delayed confirmation timer.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for a Wearable Android app, handling gestures, notifications, overlay views, and timer events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, view references, gesture detector, and overlay view.

methods.name: dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Delegates touch events to gesture detector and superclass.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification with an action button that launches another activity.

methods.name: onFinishActivity
methods.description: Sets the result and finishes the activity.

methods.name: onStartTimer
methods.description: Starts a delayed confirmation countdown timer and scrolls down.

methods.name: onTimerFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when the timer finishes, scrolling up.

methods.name: onTimerSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when the timer is selected, scrolling up.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the ScrollView either up or down based on the direction argument.
